verdict.rationale: Remote documents a single platform covering global payroll, EOR and contractor management, with contractor payment in 190+ countries and EOR hiring in 90+ countries. All employment types are created through one endpoint, so paying employees and contractors from one platform is evidenced. Nothing addresses the US-specific W-2 employee payroll or 1099 contractor handling the story names. missing for 10: explicit US W-2 payroll support, 1099 contractor tax-form handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of unified employee-plus-contractor pay runs.
